DV 10

Select one piece of cyberware other than a Neuroport or Neuroport Cyberdeck Port.

The selected cyberware becomes inoperable for 20 Rounds.

Cyberlimbs act as Broken Arm or Broken Leg Critical Injuries while disabled.

All attached cyberware options cease functioning.
